<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="y75fRrvrGxmCjmKCraBr"> <mxGraphModel dx="1515" dy="815" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
!pragma layout smetana
skinparam componentStyle rectangle

' Define the external entities (Rectangles)
rectangle \"Director\" as Dir
rectangle \"Distributor\" as Dist
rectangle \"Stock Manager\" as SM
rectangle \"Accountant\" as Acc
rectangle \"System Admin\" as Admin
rectangle \"Email/SMS Gateway API\" as API

' Define the main system (Circle/Oval)
usecase \"SmartStream\nIntegrated Business\nManagement System\" as System

' Draw the data flows (Arrows)
Dist --> System : Invoice Images, GPS Location
System --> Dist : Delivery Routes, App Alerts

SM --> System : Inventory Adjustments
System --> SM : Inventory Reports

System --> Dir : Financial Reports, Dashboard Data
Dir --> System : Query Requests

System --> Acc : Unapproved Invoices, Ledger Data
Acc --> System : Invoice Approvals

Admin --> System : RBAC Updates, System Configs
System --> Admin : System Logs, Backup Status

System --> API : Low Stock Alert Triggers
API --> SM : (Delivers external SMS/Email)

@enduml",
 "format": "svg"
}" id="r1Nt8U0InX8paQAvdc6R-3"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="344" width="1496" x="90" y="120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml

System --> Admin : System Logs, Backup Status

System --> API : Low Stock Alert Triggers
API --> SM : (Delivers external SMS/Email)

@enduml",

}" id="zKNVjO8YYQhX4V-MuvKr-1"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="344" width="1496" x="90" y="120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
